fields.label: Title
fields.default: Moving your business banking takes one afternoon

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: We handle the paperwork with your old bank. You keep trading the whole time.

default.title: Open your account online
default.text: Answer a few questions about your business on your phone or laptop. Most accounts are approved within ten minutes, and your new card ships the same day.

default.title: Verify who you are
default.text: Take a photo of your passport or driving licence and record a short selfie video. Directors can each verify from their own phone.

default.title: Move your payments across
default.text: Tell us your old account details and we copy over every standing order and direct debit. Customers who pay you are redirected automatically for three years.

default.title: Close the old account
default.text: When the switch completes on day seven we close your old account and move the remaining balance. You get an email with a full record of what moved.
